Name: Luwen's Heart-shaped ballon furniture
Author: Luwenl
Description:
About This Mod

This mod adds [b]Luwen's Heart-Shaped Balloon Furniture[/b], converted from the original scarecrow retexture into placeable furniture.
The balloons are designed to add a [b]cute and decorative atmosphere[/b] to your farm.


Requirements[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿[/b]
[/list]How to Obtain

You can purchase the [b]catalog from Robin for 5,000g[/b].
Each balloon has its own price, but once you buy the catalog, you can place them [b]for free[/b].

Notes

This furniture version was converted from the [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43170]Heart-Shaped Balloon Scarecrow retexture[/url][/b].


EnjoyI hope you enjoy decorating your farm with these balloons!

Downloads.Description: Decorate your farm with cute balloon furniture ~ <3
